proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D _ _ h hd
  have hCA : C -ᵥ A = (B -ᵥ A) + (D -ᵥ A) := by
    rw [h, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]
  have hDB : D -ᵥ B = (D -ᵥ A) - (B -ᵥ A) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right D B A).symm
  rw [dist_comm A C, dist_comm B D, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V D B, hCA, hDB] at hd
  have h1 := norm_add_sq_real (B -ᵥ A) (D -ᵥ A)
  have h2 := norm_sub_sq_real (D -ᵥ A) (B -ᵥ A)
  rw [real_inner_comm] at h1
  rw [hd] at h1
  apply (InnerProductGeometry.inner_eq_zero_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two _ _).mp
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), A ≠ B → A ≠ D → B -ᵥ A = C -ᵥ D → dist A C = dist B D → EuclideanGeometry.angle D A B = Real.pi / 2
